theses.thesis: After the longest losing streak in 25 years, driven by foreign selling, crude and the rupee, large private banks with purely domestic earnings and clean balance sheets recover first when the selling exhausts.
theses.invalidation: Nifty closes more than 5% below its 15 Oct 2026 level (22,623) on a sustained basis, or ICICI Q2/Q3 results show rising slippages (gross NPA up quarter on quarter)

closed.thesis: Rate-sensitive lenders move on RBI policy days; be positioned two weeks before the December 2026 meeting, not after, and let a pre-written rule decide the exit.

Rising crude and a weak rupee lift the rupee realisation of an oil producer (ONGC) and squeeze the marketing margin of a refiner-marketer that cannot pass pump prices through quickly (HPCL). Long the winner, paper-short the loser.

Test the "strong results, stock still falls" pattern: Waaree has dropped after each of its last two strong quarters; be positioned before Q2 FY27 results and exit the day after, whatever the numbers say.
